propositions: Close unconditionally calls the completion verifier provider even when the ticket already contains a cryptographically certified completion-verifier PASS attestation bound to the same resolved ref.

The existing close autoresume seam never consults the ticket's stored completion op-cert before invoking the provider, despite the signature infrastructure already authenticating the record and exposing its signed SHA and material fingerprint.

A same-ref close with a valid stored completion PASS should bypass the provider dispatch and reuse the attested result, producing zero completion-provider calls while maintaining durable evidence and signed close output.
Ineligible attestations—those with changed ref, invalid signature, missing SHA pin, stale material, FAIL status, or reopen invalidation—must fall through to fresh provider verification.
